_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks 'Don't show this again'; closing with X or Esc dismisses for that session only. Change 'id' for a NEW message. mode 'every' shows on every visit until 'Don't show again' (X, Esc and 'Maybe later' remember nothing). Other modes: 'once', 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'. A message can also run for a set time: "until" (YYYY-MM-DD) ends it and "then" holds the announcement that takes over. layout 'hero' is the big-photo card: hero.photo/alt/tag, 'logo' badge, 'laterLabel' (this visit) and 'dismissLabel' (for good). layout 'build' is the blueprint card: build.kicker (big gold word), build.headline, and build.items (up to four: photo, alt, school, sport, note, logo); the photos print in one by one, then a spotlight moves from team to team.
